verses.html: A Song of degrees of David. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.text: A Song of degrees of David. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.title: A Song of degrees of David.
verses.titleHtml: A Song of degrees of David.

verses.html: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.text: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.html: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.html: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.text: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

verses.html: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.text: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.html: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.html: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.text: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.html: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.text: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

verses.html: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.text: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
